scope: Environment dataset coverage of the Plateway delivery dataset plateway-delivery-2025-2026, whole window. Not a Task history report: a Task reports its own selection after its first-session cutoff (dataset/as-of.cjs).
counting: Every timestamp is ISO 8601 with its offset; each is converted to its calendar date in America/New_York before counting. No record is date-only. A date counts once however many records or sources fall on it. Records outside the window and invalid dates would be excluded and listed; there are none.

sources.role: Seed at the window start 2025-01-01T00:00:00-05:00: the account, addresses, cards, zones, restaurants and menu with the earlier prices; no orders.
Every committed step in time order: the account holder's tool calls and Infra events, each with its time.
Seed at 2027-01-01T00:00:00-05:00, the state after every step: all records of the window.

exclusions.reason: Catalog records describe the menu as it stands and carry no occurrence date; their dated changes are the replay steps menu_item.price_changed, menu_item.availability_changed and restaurant.status_changed.

exclusions.reason: Account rows with no occurrence date.
Holds only the account and catalog at the window start; no dated records.

distinct_dates.coverage_basis: Counted over the records loaded into the App (dataset/full.json), which Agents and Infra read back.
distinct_dates.coverage_note: The global count over both sources adds 21 days on which the replay log holds only 26 cart edits and 27 menu or restaurant events; those days have no App record.

provenance.note: Every record and step is synthetic, written by the App while dataset/generate.cjs replayed it; none was collected or observed.

partitions.partition: synthetic, dated before the reference clock
synthetic, dated at or after the reference clock: generated, never observed

gaps.reason: DoorDash is only the workflow reference. The approved proposal (proposals/environment/plateway-delivery.md, line 96: "N/A: no crawling or copied menus") excludes collecting its data, and Plateway's restaurants, menus, couriers and account are invented, so there is no real source to collect around November 2026; the whole window is synthetic.
The 613 notices are in the App's own notice log only; the dataset holds no Mail history for them. Mail is optional, and the Mail sender treats notices present in a loaded seed as history.

loading.interface: Real Core 1.6.0 over MCP stdio: Infra loads each selection with env.load_seed (data, virtual_now and provenance bundle) and reads env.snapshot; the Agent reads plateway.account.get, plateway.orders.list, plateway.orders.get for every listed order, plateway.cart.get and plateway.menu_items.get; the first staged event, if any, is applied with env.apply_event.
